decisions.reason: It survived the initial screening period and fits the platform well, but as a somewhat niche sensor module it faces moderate risk from demand uncertainty or component changes.
As the 3.0 successor to an established voltage-measurement module, it is closely tied to core customer needs and likely performs above aspiration levels.
A CAN bus interface is a strong fit with German industrial and automation applications, so the module is likely to remain acceptable within the firm's portfolio.
The CO2 sensor module complements the firm's sensing lineup and likely benefits from sustained monitoring demand, even if sensor supply or overlap with other air-quality products creates some risk.
